name: experience-layer-execution-plan-doc
title: Land the Lattice Experience Layer (evidence-backed review playbooks) execution plan into docs/requirements/decisions/ — English, code-verified, advisory-only and deterministic-preserving
description: Materialize the v1.1 Experience Layer specification as an English execution-plan decision document at docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md. The doc is a future-execution plan only (no source code): it defines an advisory-only, lineage-backed review-playbook layer that surfaces verified past story outcomes as review-time hints, never touching gate or deterministic logic. It records the grounded module decomposition (new core plus handler modules under packages/main, one-way inward coupling), the reuse of existing dev-memory, the decision-doc-promotion digest pattern and the activity-log appender, the decision to cut full-text search for v1, three determinism guardrails, and the phased rollout whose first story is a verifiable finding-signals slice.
